mapping.summary: Connects production scales to BC for weighing orders and automatic consumption posting.
claims: Designed for regulated settings and meets FDA, EU GMP, ISO 13485, MDR and IVDR requirements
Talks to scales from Mettler Toledo, Sartorius, Bizerba, Precisia, Söhnle and others via a scale management system
Can be linked with Yaveon 365 Manufacturing and Lot Management
Shows hazardous substance symbols on the scale screen
Supports cyclic hardware tests, mobile and fixed scale stations and per-user scale permissions
Weighing orders are created in BC and sent to the scale system
Posts consumption automatically, optionally correcting small stock deviations
Tolerance limits guard against weighing errors and waste
Supports individual and additive weighing steps
Calculates component shares from active ingredient values of the actual batch
With Rule Management only permitted lots can be weighed
Items without lots or active ingredients can also be weighed
Production weighing is available now; QC, receipt and shipping weighing are announced as coming
